feeds.title: Crumbs & Doilies
feeds.description: Crumbs & Doilies produces the best-tasting and best-looking cakes, bakes & cupcakes people have ever tasted or laid eyes on!

feeds.title: Traditional Home Baking
feeds.description: My name is Lynn Hill. I'm a cook book author, food writer, member of the guild of food writers, and a self-taught home baker living in the UK. Discover easy to make recipes for the home cook and new baker. Find recipes for the perfect Afternoon Tea, weekend bake, bake sales, and more. From a simple Victoria Sponge Cake to a delicious Vanilla and Coconut Cake.

feeds.title: Lindy's Cakes Ltd
feeds.description: Lindy Smith is a Award winning, best-selling author and cake designer, who loves to create wedding cakes, inspire, teach and supply you with gorgeous products. Her first cake decorating book 'Hobby Cakes' was published in 2000. She has continued to write books ever since, loving the freedom it gives her to be highly creative and original. So far she has written thirteen books.

feeds.title: Cake Dutchess Blog
feeds.description: Bringing you the best possible products to create amazing cakes and modelling projects, as well as my help in any modelling project you might have. I love connecting with people all over the world sharing the same passion for Cake Decorating and Modelling. I feel that we speak one language through this hobby!

feeds.title: Mummy Mishaps » Cakes
feeds.description: Mummy Mishaps is me Jenny, a mostly SAHM who is definitely a clumsy mumsy! I mostly blog about my love of baking - especially cakes. I LOVE cakes and there are lots on here so please have a look.

feeds.title: Elizabeth's Cake Emporium
feeds.description: Elizabeth's Cake Emporium founded by Elizabeth Solaru is recognised as one of the best wedding cake companies in the UK.

feeds.title: Dragons & Daffodils Cakes Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning cakes and classes by Author and Judge Rhianydd Webb. 21 years of creating exquisite bespoke gold-medal wedding cakes, teaching and demonstrating hand-made sugar and wafer paper flowers, modeled figures, and sculpted cakes all around the world.

feeds.title: Cake by Sadie Smith Blog
feeds.description: I am a Dorset based cake company specializing in Bespoke Wedding Cakes, Celebration Cakes, Birthday Cakes and Cupcakes covering Wimborne, Poole, Bournemouth and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Hello Cuppies » Cake Recipes
feeds.description: I'm Natalie, and I run a bespoke cake company called Cuppies 'n' Cream. I've been baking professionally since 2011 and I picked up the caking bug after baking some cupcakes for a friend's daughter. I am completely self taught and have developed my skills by experimenting and creating lots of new flavours and combinations along the way.

feeds.title: Mr Baker's Blog
feeds.description: A primary school teacher by day, it was only after being asked to make a birthday cake for a friend's daughter that Rob Baker-Gall better known as Mr Baker's Cakes caught the bug for cake artistry and it is safe to say he was hooked.

feeds.title: Cake Cabinet Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog, where we share all things related to cake decorating, whether its recipes, how to's and tips and tricks.
